text: Risk management is the process of identifying, assessing, and controlling threats to an organization. It begins with identifying risks—finding out what could go wrong, whether it's financial loss, cyberattacks, or natural disasters. Once risks are identified, businesses develop mitigation strategies to reduce their impact, such as improving security or diversifying investments. They also create contingency plans, which are backup plans for emergencies. Finally, monitoring is essential. Risks change over time, so companies must regularly review their strategies and stay alert to new threats. Effective risk management helps organizations protect their assets, make better decisions, and respond quickly when problems arise.
